reserves.name: Australian-dollar reserves in designated bank accounts

sources.label: Aura Partners AUDX Limited Assurance Report - June 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The June 30, 2026 report records AUD 3,231,280.83 in designated reserve bank accounts against AUDX 3,008,057.00 of reported supply (Polygon 1,321,016; Ethereum 1,435,040; Conflux 52,000; Redbelly 100,000; XDC 50,000; Ink 50,000; Solana 1), signed by the CEO on 2026-07-06 with an Aura Partners independent limited-assurance report under ASAE 3000/ASAE 3100. Aura Partners independently confirmed the reserve balances directly with the relevant financial institutions and reconciled them to the issued supply; the institutions and account-level allocation are not disclosed. The report confirms all reserves are held in segregated accounts, separate from operational and corporate funds, and unencumbered. Write-time re-open 2026-07-30: the transparency archive now lists monthly reports through 30 June 2026; the June PDF is the latest and still states reserves in designated bank accounts >= supply. The June report enumerates supply on Redbelly, Ink, and Solana, chains not present in the tracked contracts list.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: AUDX reserve verification subject to Aura Partners limited assurance as of June 30, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report establishes that the full reserve is held in designated bank accounts, but does not name the financial institutions or disclose provider shares and deposit terms.
